payout_quote: 360 Performance Savings: 'APY (Annual Percentage Yield) is variable and effective 9/22/2026.' 'Unlike tiered savings accounts, Capital One's 360 Performance Savings account offers the same high-yield savings rate on your entire balance.' 'Interest accrues daily and compounds monthly.' FDIC-insured up to the allowable limits. No fees to open or keep; no minimum balance. This is interest on your own deposits, not a signup bonus.
timing: No signup bonus exists. Variable APY effective 9/22/2026; interest accrues daily and compounds monthly. Approved applicants have 60 days to fund the account.
eligibility: Name, date of birth, mailing address, email, phone number, employment information, annual income, Tax ID Number (SSN or ITIN), and citizenship information required. Account subject to approval; denial possible. Must fund within 60 days of approval.
biggest_catch: There is no signup bonus — the only 'payout' is variable interest on your own deposits, and the exact current APY figure is rendered client-side on capitalone.com (it could not be captured this session), so confirm the live rate yourself before opening.
catches: No signup bonus exists on capitalone.com — the only 'payout' is variable interest on your own deposits.
The headline APY number is JS-rendered on capitalone.com and could not be captured this session; the rate is variable and can change at any time before or after opening.
360 Performance Savings has no ATM or debit card — withdraw online or at a branch, or transfer to a 360 Checking account for ATM access.

A separate 360 Performance Savings referral program exists ($100 per referred friend who opens and completes steps; friend 'welcome bonus of up to $1,500' by deposit tier, paid within 60 days) — but it is referral-based, not a signup bonus for opening an account.
Deposit accounts opened on or after May 18, 2025 are immediately counted with your other Capital One accounts for FDIC insurance purposes.
steps: Go to http://www.capitalone.com/bank/savings-accounts/online-performance-savings-account/ and start the application (about 5 minutes).
Provide name, DOB, mailing address, email, phone, employment info, income, SSN/ITIN, and citizenship info; agree to terms.
On approval, fund the account within 60 days — no minimum balance required (your first-deposit account links automatically).
Keep funds parked; interest accrues daily and compounds monthly at the variable APY (effective 9/22/2026).
Withdraw online or at a branch; to use an ATM, first transfer to a linked 360 Checking account.
